name: okrapdf
description: Parse PDFs on your own computer: an offline MCP server with page-and-box citations for every block, a local dashboard with hover source mapping, local models, your own API keys, and ParseBench scoring.

interface.shortDescription: Parse PDFs offline, with page-and-box citations
interface.longDescription: Parse a PDF on your own computer and get every block with its page and box, so each answer cites its source. The text layer is free and offline; local models (Ollama, LM Studio) and your own API keys handle scans. Open the dashboard to see the PDF beside its blocks, and score models with ParseBench. No account.
defaultPrompt: Find the total revenue in this PDF and cite the page
Parse this PDF and show me the tables
Open this PDF in the okraPDF dashboard
